# WallPaint

Wall paint lets players use the spray painter on reinforced and plastitanium walls, including their diagonal variants.
Mappers can set `painted: true` and `color` on the wall's `WGPaintableWall` component in map data; the color is
restored when the map loads.

The server entry point is `WGWallPaintSystem`; the client visual system applies paint to the walls' masked surface
layers without recoloring their metallic trim and shadows.
